definition: A paper cover for documents; a place for files on a computer.
examples: Put the papers in a blue folder.
Save the photos in a new folder.
She took a file from the folder.

spanish.definition: Cubierta de papel para documentos; lugar para archivos en una computadora.

definition: A bright pen for marking important words.
examples: She marked the page with a yellow highlighter.
I need a new highlighter.
He studies with a highlighter in his hand.

spanish.definition: Marcador brillante para señalar palabras importantes.

definition: A thick pen.
examples: Write your name with a black marker.
The kids drew with colored markers.
This marker is dry.

spanish.definition: Bolígrafo grueso.

definition: A stick of colored wax for drawing.
examples: The children colored with crayons.
He drew a house in red crayon.
She got a box of 64 crayons.

spanish.definition: Barra de cera de color para dibujar.

definition: A tool for making pencils sharp.
examples: The pencil sharpener is on the teacher's desk.
Do you have a sharpener?
She bought an electric sharpener.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para afilar lápices.

definition: A large African animal with a horn on its nose.
examples: We saw a rhino on our safari.
Rhinos have very thick skin.
There are few rhinos left in the wild.

spanish.definition: Animal africano grande con un cuerno en la nariz.

definition: A wild cat with spots that runs very fast.
examples: The cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
A cheetah chased the deer.
Cheetahs live in Africa.

spanish.definition: Gato salvaje con manchas que corre muy rápido.

definition: An African wild animal that sounds like it is laughing.
examples: We heard hyenas at night.
Hyenas hunt in groups.
The hyena stole the meat.

spanish.definition: Animal salvaje africano que suena como si se riera.

definition: A small river animal with brown fur.
examples: An otter was swimming in the river.
Otters love to play.
The sea otter floated on its back.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño de río con pelaje marrón.

definition: A large sea animal with two long teeth.
examples: A walrus lives in very cold water.
The walrus has long white tusks.
We saw a walrus at the aquarium.

spanish.definition: Animal marino grande con dos dientes largos.

definition: A sea animal with eight arms.
examples: An octopus has eight arms.
We ate grilled octopus in Spain.
The octopus hid under a rock.

spanish.definition: Animal de mar con ocho brazos.

definition: A sea animal shaped like a star.
examples: We found a starfish on the beach.
A starfish has five arms.
The kids picked up a little starfish.

spanish.definition: Animal de mar con forma de estrella.

definition: A small sea fish with a head like a horse.
examples: The seahorse held on to the plant.
We saw seahorses at the aquarium.
A seahorse swims standing up.

spanish.definition: Pez pequeño de mar con cabeza de caballo.

definition: A small bird with a red chest.
examples: A robin built a nest in our tree.
I saw the first robin of spring.
The robin pulled a worm from the ground.

spanish.definition: Ave pequeña con el pecho rojo.

definition: A small brown bird.
examples: A sparrow landed on the window.
Sparrows live in most cities.
The kids fed bread to the sparrows.

spanish.definition: Ave pequeña y marrón.

definition: A very large bird that can't fly.
examples: An ostrich can run very fast.
Ostrich eggs are huge.
The ostrich has long legs.

spanish.definition: Ave muy grande que no puede volar.

definition: A tall pink bird with long legs.
examples: We saw flamingos at the zoo.
The flamingo stood on one leg.
Flamingos live in large groups.

spanish.definition: Ave alta y rosada de patas largas.

definition: A large sea bird with a big bag under its beak.
examples: A pelican dove into the water.
Pelicans eat fish.
We saw pelicans at the beach in Florida.

spanish.definition: Ave marina grande con una bolsa bajo el pico.

definition: A small round red insect with black spots.
examples: A ladybug landed on my hand.
Ladybugs are good for gardens.
The kids love finding ladybugs.

spanish.definition: Insecto pequeño, redondo y rojo con puntos negros.

definition: A long, thin flying insect with four wings.
examples: A dragonfly flew over the pond.
Dragonflies eat mosquitoes.
The kids watched a dragonfly on the lake.

spanish.definition: Insecto largo y delgado que vuela con cuatro alas.

definition: A small insect like a worm that becomes a butterfly.
examples: The caterpillar ate all the leaves.
A caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
There's a green caterpillar on the plant.

spanish.definition: Insecto pequeño parecido a un gusano que se vuelve mariposa.

definition: A small, slow animal with a shell on its back.
examples: There's a snail on the wall.
Snails move very slowly.
People eat snails in France.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño y lento con una concha en la espalda.

definition: A small soft animal like a snail without a shell.
examples: Slugs ate my lettuce.
There's a slug on the path.
Slugs come out after the rain.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño y blando parecido a un caracol sin concha.

definition: A bird that makes holes in trees with its beak.
examples: I heard a woodpecker in the forest.
A woodpecker made a hole in the tree.
The woodpecker has a red head.

spanish.definition: Ave que hace huecos en los árboles con el pico.

definition: A very small bird that moves its wings very fast.
examples: A hummingbird stopped at the flower.
Hummingbirds can fly backward.
We feed the hummingbirds sugar water.

spanish.definition: Ave muy pequeña que mueve las alas muy rápido.

definition: A small yellow bird that sings.
examples: My grandmother has a pet canary.
The canary sings every morning.
She kept a canary in a cage.

spanish.definition: Ave pequeña y amarilla que canta.

definition: A slow animal with a hard shell that lives on land.
examples: The tortoise beat the hare.
A tortoise can live for 100 years.
We saw giant tortoises in the Galápagos.

spanish.definition: Animal lento de caparazón duro que vive en la tierra.

definition: A dog with thick, curly hair.
examples: My aunt has a little white poodle.
Poodles are very smart dogs.
The poodle barked at me.

spanish.definition: Perro de pelo grueso y rizado.

definition: A large wild cat from South America.
examples: Jaguars live in the rainforest.
A jaguar is a very strong swimmer.
We never saw a jaguar in the Amazon.

spanish.definition: Gato salvaje grande de Suramérica.

definition: A large bird that eats dead animals.
examples: Vultures flew over the desert.
A vulture landed on the dead deer.
The vulture has no feathers on its head.

spanish.definition: Ave grande que come animales muertos.

definition: A large deer that lives in cold places.
examples: Santa's sleigh is pulled by reindeer.
Reindeer live in Norway.
Rudolph is a famous reindeer.

spanish.definition: Venado grande que vive en lugares fríos.

definition: A fast bird that hunts small animals.
examples: A falcon can dive very fast.
He trains falcons.
The falcon caught a small bird.

spanish.definition: Ave rápida que caza animales pequeños.

definition: A very dangerous snake from Asia or Africa.
examples: A cobra rose up from the basket.
Cobras are very dangerous.
The cobra opened its hood.

spanish.definition: Serpiente muy peligrosa de Asia o África.

definition: A large black wild cat.
examples: The panther moved silently through the trees.
Florida has a few wild panthers.
A black panther lay on the branch.

spanish.definition: Gato salvaje grande y negro.

definition: A storm with thunder and lightning.
examples: A thunderstorm woke me up.
We got caught in a thunderstorm.
There are thunderstorms this afternoon.

spanish.definition: Tormenta con truenos y relámpagos.

definition: Light rain.
examples: We walked home in a light drizzle.
There's some drizzle this morning.
The drizzle stopped at noon.

spanish.definition: Lluvia ligera.

definition: With a lot of water in the air.
examples: It's very humid in Florida.
The air was hot and humid.
Humid weather makes me tired.

spanish.definition: Con mucha agua en el aire.

definition: Red, painful skin from too much sun.
examples: I got a bad sunburn at the beach.
This cream is good for sunburn.
Her nose has a sunburn.

spanish.definition: Piel roja y adolorida por demasiado sol.

definition: A marked place where people cross a street.
examples: Use the crosswalk.
Cars must stop at the crosswalk.
She waited at the crosswalk.

spanish.definition: Lugar marcado donde la gente cruza la calle.

definition: A road or a bridge that goes over another road.
examples: The truck was too tall for the overpass.
We drove under the overpass.
People crossed the highway on the overpass.

spanish.definition: Calle o puente que pasa por encima de otra calle.

definition: A short stop between two flights.
examples: We have a three-hour layover in Miami.
There's a long layover in Panama.
I hate long layovers.

spanish.definition: Parada corta entre dos vuelos.

definition: A cheap place to stay, often for young travelers.
examples: We stayed at a youth hostel in Peru.
The hostel costs twenty dollars a night.
She met her husband at a hostel.

spanish.definition: Lugar barato para quedarse, a menudo para viajeros jóvenes.

definition: A place where you pay to wash your clothes.
examples: I wash my clothes at the laundromat.
There's a laundromat on the corner.
She met him at the laundromat.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde pagas por lavar tu ropa.

definition: A place where men get their hair cut.
examples: He went to the barbershop for a haircut.
My dad owns a barbershop.
There's a new barbershop downtown.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde a los hombres les cortan el pelo.

definition: The place on a computer where you get emails.
examples: My inbox is full.
Check your inbox for a message from us.
I have 200 emails in my inbox.

spanish.definition: Lugar en la computadora donde recibes correos.

definition: The name you use to enter a website.
examples: Enter your username and password.
I forgot my username.
That username is already taken.

spanish.definition: Nombre que usas para entrar a un sitio web.

definition: The act of entering a computer system; the name and password.
examples: I need your login to open the file.
The login page isn't working.
Enter your login details.

spanish.definition: Acto de entrar a un sistema; nombre y contraseña.

definition: One page on a website.
examples: The webpage won't load.
Click the link to open the webpage.
She designed a webpage for her shop.

spanish.definition: Una página de un sitio web.

definition: A program for looking at websites.
examples: Open your browser and go to our site.
Which web browser do you use?
Update your browser first.

spanish.definition: Programa para ver sitios web.

definition: A computer that stays on a desk; the main screen of a computer.
examples: I have a desktop at home.
Save the file on your desktop.
She prefers a desktop to a laptop.

spanish.definition: Computadora que se queda en un escritorio; pantalla principal.

definition: A machine that copies a document into a computer.
examples: Put the page on the scanner.
We have a printer and a scanner.
Airports use body scanners.

spanish.definition: Máquina que copia un documento a una computadora.

definition: To send a file from your device to the internet.
examples: I uploaded the photos.
She uploads a video every week.
The file is uploading now.

spanish.definition: Enviar un archivo de tu aparato a internet.

definition: A wireless internet connection.
examples: What's the wifi password?
The hotel has free wifi.
The wifi is very slow here.

spanish.definition: Conexión inalámbrica a internet.

definition: A device that connects you to the internet.
examples: Try turning the router off and on.
The router is in the living room.
We need a faster router.

spanish.definition: Aparato que te conecta a internet.

definition: A break for playing during the school day.
examples: The kids play outside at recess.
Recess is at ten o'clock.
He lost his recess for talking.

spanish.definition: Descanso para jugar durante el día de escuela.

definition: A curved nut.
examples: I love roasted cashews.
She added cashews to the rice.
Cashews are expensive.

spanish.definition: Fruto seco curvo.

definition: A small, round, flat seed that you cook.
examples: We had lentil soup for lunch.
Lentils are high in protein.
She cooked the lentils with onions.

spanish.definition: Semilla pequeña, redonda y plana que se cocina.

definition: A long green vegetable.
examples: She grilled some zucchini.
We grow zucchini in the garden.
I put zucchini in the pasta.

spanish.definition: Verdura larga y verde.

definition: A green vegetable with long stems.
examples: We had asparagus with the fish.
Grill the asparagus for five minutes.
I don't really like asparagus.

spanish.definition: Verdura verde de tallos largos.

definition: A round white vegetable.
examples: We had cauliflower with cheese.
Cut the cauliflower into small pieces.
She made a cauliflower soup.

spanish.definition: Verdura blanca y redonda.

definition: A round, dark red root vegetable.
examples: I put beets in my salad.
Beet juice stains your hands.
Her face turned red as a beet.

spanish.definition: Raíz redonda de color rojo oscuro.

definition: A small red root vegetable with a strong taste.
examples: She sliced a radish for the salad.
Radishes grow fast.
This radish is very hot.

spanish.definition: Raíz pequeña y roja de sabor fuerte.

definition: A small brown fruit that is green inside.
examples: I had a kiwi for breakfast.
Peel the kiwi before you eat it.
She put kiwi on the cake.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña y marrón, verde por dentro.

definition: A large tropical fruit with orange flesh.
examples: We ate fresh papaya in Cartagena.
Papaya is good for your stomach.
She made a papaya juice.

spanish.definition: Fruta tropical grande de pulpa naranja.

definition: A small, soft orange fruit.
examples: She made apricot jam.
I bought some dried apricots.
This apricot is very sweet.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña, suave y anaranjada.

definition: A small, sweet orange fruit.
examples: She peeled a tangerine.
Tangerines are easy to peel.
I put a tangerine in his lunch.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña, dulce y anaranjada.

definition: A thin, round, flat Mexican bread.
examples: Wrap the meat in a tortilla.
We bought corn tortillas.
She makes fresh tortillas every day.

spanish.definition: Pan mexicano delgado, redondo y plano.

definition: A large tortilla filled with meat and beans.
examples: I ordered a chicken burrito.
This burrito is huge.
We got burritos for lunch.

spanish.definition: Tortilla grande rellena de carne y frijoles.

definition: A sweet herb used in Italian food.
examples: Add some fresh basil to the pasta.
I grow basil in the kitchen.
The sauce smells of basil.

spanish.definition: Hierba dulce usada en la comida italiana.

definition: A green herb with small leaves.
examples: Sprinkle some parsley on top.
The fish came with parsley.
She chopped some fresh parsley.

spanish.definition: Hierba verde de hojas pequeñas.

definition: A dark green leafy vegetable.
examples: She puts kale in her smoothies.
Kale is very healthy.
I ordered a kale salad.

spanish.definition: Verdura de hojas verde oscuro.

definition: A soft French roll shaped like a curve.
examples: I had a croissant and a coffee.
She bought fresh croissants.
This butter croissant is delicious.

spanish.definition: Pan francés suave con forma curva.

definition: A thin, dry, salty cookie.
examples: We ate cheese and crackers.
Put some crackers in your soup.
The baby is eating a cracker.

spanish.definition: Galleta delgada, seca y salada.

definition: A breakfast food of oats, nuts, and honey.
examples: I eat granola with yogurt.
She made her own granola.
This granola is very sweet.

spanish.definition: Comida de desayuno de avena, nueces y miel.

definition: Coffee with a lot of hot milk.
examples: I'd like a large latte, please.
She orders a vanilla latte every day.
This latte is too hot.

spanish.definition: Café con mucha leche caliente.

definition: Strong coffee in a small cup.
examples: He drank a quick espresso.
I need a double espresso.
We bought an espresso machine.

spanish.definition: Café fuerte en una taza pequeña.

definition: Coffee with hot milk and foam.
examples: I'd like a cappuccino, please.
She had a cappuccino after lunch.
The cappuccino here is excellent.

spanish.definition: Café con leche caliente y espuma.

definition: A drink made from apples.
examples: We drank hot apple cider.
I bought a gallon of cider at the farm.
Cider is popular in the fall.

spanish.definition: Bebida hecha de manzanas.

definition: A hard candy on a stick.
examples: The kid had a red lollipop.
The doctor gave her a lollipop.
He's sucking on a lollipop.

spanish.definition: Dulce duro en un palito.

definition: A pain in your stomach.
examples: I have a bad stomachache.
He ate too much and got a stomachache.
Milk gives me a stomachache.

spanish.definition: Dolor en el estómago.

definition: A pain in your back.
examples: I woke up with a backache.
This chair gives me a backache.
She suffers from backaches.

spanish.definition: Dolor en la espalda.

definition: A pain in your ear.
examples: My son has an earache.
She couldn't sleep because of an earache.
The doctor gave me drops for my earache.

spanish.definition: Dolor en el oído.

definition: A small bubble on your skin from rubbing or burning.
examples: These new shoes gave me a blister.
He got blisters on his hands.
Don't pop the blister.

spanish.definition: Burbuja pequeña en la piel por roce o quemadura.

definition: A long stick that helps you walk after an injury.
examples: He's on crutches because of his foot.
She used crutches for six weeks.
I lost one crutch at the hospital.

spanish.definition: Palo largo que te ayuda a caminar después de una lesión.

definition: A small chair on wheels for a baby.
examples: She pushed the baby in a stroller.
We folded the stroller and put it in the car.
This stroller is very light.

spanish.definition: Silla pequeña con ruedas para un bebé.

definition: A rubber object for a baby to suck.
examples: The baby dropped her pacifier.
He won't sleep without his pacifier.
We have to stop using the pacifier.

spanish.definition: Objeto de caucho para que un bebé chupe.

definition: A small bike with three wheels.
examples: My son rides a tricycle.
She got a red tricycle for her birthday.
The little girl pedaled her tricycle.

spanish.definition: Bicicleta pequeña con tres ruedas.

definition: A cart with one wheel, used for moving dirt.
examples: He filled the wheelbarrow with leaves.
We moved the rocks in a wheelbarrow.
The wheelbarrow is in the shed.

spanish.definition: Carro de una rueda para mover tierra.

definition: A device that sprays water on the grass.
examples: The kids ran through the sprinkler.
Turn on the sprinkler in the morning.
The fire sprinklers came on.

spanish.definition: Aparato que rocía agua sobre el pasto.

definition: A flat tool for collecting dirt from the floor.
examples: Get the broom and the dustpan.
She swept the glass into the dustpan.
The dustpan is under the sink.

spanish.definition: Herramienta plana para recoger la suciedad del piso.

definition: A very large metal container for trash.
examples: Throw that in the dumpster.
There's a dumpster behind the restaurant.
They rented a dumpster for the old furniture.

spanish.definition: Recipiente de metal muy grande para basura.

definition: A sweater that opens at the front.
examples: She wore a gray cardigan.
Grandpa loves his old cardigan.
Take a cardigan in case it gets cold.

spanish.definition: Suéter que se abre por delante.

definition: A formal jacket.
examples: He wore a navy blazer.
She put a blazer over her dress.
Students wear a school blazer.

spanish.definition: Chaqueta formal.

definition: Pants with a part that covers your chest.
examples: The farmer wore blue overalls.
My son looks cute in overalls.
Painters often wear white overalls.

spanish.definition: Pantalón con una parte que cubre el pecho.

definition: A soft coat you wear after a bath.
examples: He got the newspaper in his bathrobe.
The hotel gives you a bathrobe.
She put on her bathrobe and slippers.

spanish.definition: Abrigo suave que usas después del baño.

definition: The man you are going to marry.
examples: This is my fiance, Tom.
Her fiance lives in Chicago.
She met her fiance at work.

spanish.definition: Hombre con el que te vas a casar.

definition: A man who delivers letters.
examples: The mailman comes at noon.
Our dog hates the mailman.
Did the mailman bring anything?

spanish.definition: Hombre que entrega las cartas.

definition: A person who makes coffee in a coffee shop.
examples: She works as a barista.
The barista wrote my name on the cup.
Ask the barista for a recommendation.

spanish.definition: Persona que prepara café en una cafetería.

definition: With no limit.
examples: My phone plan has unlimited data.
The gym offers unlimited classes.
You get unlimited free coffee here.

spanish.definition: Sin límite.

definition: So special that you always remember it.
examples: It was an unforgettable trip.
The view is unforgettable.
She gave an unforgettable performance.

spanish.definition: Tan especial que siempre lo recuerdas.
